'''Tal Ker''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Grand Library}} in the {{zone|Dwarven Mines}}. They have 173 lines of dialogue and give no reward once finished with it. The player must click for each line, or alternatively hold right click. After the dialogue is finished, Tal Ker will not talk again upon clicking him. 

__TOC__

== Trivia ==
* '''Tal Ker'''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s name is a play on the word "talker".
* It takes an average of 6 minutes to talk to them with his full dialogue. This can be skipped by trying to [[Vacuum]] him while he talks. <!-- ??? -->
* Crappox, guy mentioned by Tal Ker who told him to kill enemy monsters for him is likely {{NPCSprite|Maddox the Slayer}}.
**He also refers to NPCs such as {{NPCSprite|Wizard}}, {{NPCSprite|Jerry}}, an unspecified [[Island Racing]] NPC, and {{NPCSprite|Tia the Fairy}}, as well as features such as [[Harp]], [[Mayor Election]]s, [[Islands]], [[Accessories]], {{Item|Cat Talisman}} and {{Item|Black Cat Pet}}.
*Unlike most other NPCs, his dialogue progress is remembered if the player switches lobbies.
